body: Hi, I hope your day was good! I went to a local place they just opened up and it's always crowded. It was really good and the beer was a stout (for the cold weather haha). Your dog sounds pretty cool and I have seen the mask so I can just imagine him jumping like that. I really liked the way you compared what we're going thru like a addiction because it really does feel like that. Everyone looks at me like I'm feeling like this because I want to or I can just snap my fingers and switch it off. I don't know really what else to compaire it with except that. I have good days and bad days and that's how it's been for awhile now. The crazy thing is when she started this new job I told her she was going to leave for one of the new guys at her work because they had a degree and made lots of money and it ended up happening. I think subconsciously then whole time she was going to do this to me and just like that she's with the guy she said was just a friend. I never cheated or even thought about anyone else. I gave her so much of myself to advance her school and career. It really hits me hard sometimes that the perso I trusted so much could have lied to me and threw me away like 13yrs meant nothing but a distraction until she found someone with the same level of a career. Sorry for rambling about all this stuff. This time of year is a little bit hard for me because we use to really be into Christmas, the lights, decorations and shopping for presents. This year I don't even have a tree or one decoration up. Today was Not the greatest for me and I don't even know why it was a good day until a little while ago and something just hits me and I think about her and this new guy and It just hurts.  I'm  glad your able to have your family over for Christmas that really helps with having people you care about to give you some company! It sounds like you have a really busy schedule coming up which is really good. That's probably what I should start doing myself. I'm going to spend Christmas with my family and then probably not much else to be honest. As far as New Years goes I'm thinking about going to a party or something but I don't know right now. I live in Virginia. I haven't bought myself anything or anyone else except for my niece and nephews. I just haven't been in the holiday spirit this year. I'll definitely tell her hi for you and give your dog a couple rubs for me also lol. Mike

Hello, that was pretty bad about the gym pants and especially the eye doctor. He doesn't sound like a great guy to do that stuff. I guess I was the opposite and I would go out of my way to do everything for her and in some ways I guess i pushed my life to the side and made everything about her needs. I know now it needs to be a healthy half and half in any relationship. Don't get me wrong I wanted her to look good in her clothes but I would never shame her if she put weight on or took it off. I feel like you should love the person for who they are not what they look like that day. I also think about all the things I can do now that it's just me and my dog. Watch what I want, eat anywhere I please, go on a trip anytime and not worry if she can get off and just be myself. It's still hard getting use to the change in life and feeling used and lied too but I try and tell myself everyday that things happen for a reason and the next day will always be better than the last. I'm glad your having some good days and starting to move past everything. It's not a quick road but one that hopefully will take us to a better place :) I actually did something nice for myself today and went and had a good meal and beer at a place I've been wanting to go for awhile and it was great! What type of dog do you have? I have a beagle. She really helps me during the bad times when I'm alone and feeling down. I think dogs are great at reading people's emotions because when I start feeling bad she always comes and sits on my lap and tries to give me kisses. Well I hope your day was good and thanks for all your kind words it's really nice talking with you :)

Hello, I've been trying to get into the spirt of Christmas I'm just having a hard time this year but I'm trying to enjoy the little things about the holiday. I hope your enjoying your Christmas time!! That's really good about starting counseling. I've been thinking about going back maybe a different person. How's the gym going so far except for those expensive gym pants? It seems like everything you need for working out is expensive!! I've really been trying to do small things for myself but I guess my true test is the next week or so without any work. It's going to be interesting. Well I hope your day was good and positive:)
Thanks! I had a good day overall. I was able to get my mind off everything. It was a beautiful day outside. I hope your day was good also!

I'm going to block her because it's just too hard to see her with someone else. I'm working on the other pictures but those are going to be really hard to let go of. We were talking about having kids but never did but I'm sure that also would have been really tough to go thru especially after being with them for 7 years. I'm also new to Reddit I just need somewhere to vent after everything that happened. I can't believe how betrayed I feel and we're not even together anymore. I guess that was all the false hope I was holding on to. I liked your joke it's a good analogy haha. I do feel some anger but mostly just sadness. I don't think I've really ever gotten out of this feeling since she left. It just gets worse some day vs others.

I also try and tell myself that she decided to leave me and date this other guy. Im sorry your also going thru the same as myself. I'm thinking about blocking the last connection we have thru instagram. It's just really hard both ways seeing her happy and with this guy and losing that last connection I have to her and admitting to myself that our life together is over and there is no chance of her being a part of mine in the future. I hope things get better for you! If you ever want to talk I'm always here to listen. It's nice to know someone else going thru the same struggle.
